alt: Real ChatGPT /worksheet execution: fast prompt entry, sending, accelerated generation and normal-speed widget use.
caption: New temporary chat → PDF → shortcut → generation → extended widget use
prompt: /worksheet Using only the attached chapter, create an interactive three-exercise worksheet about training, inference and context. Include written-answer fields, model-answer reveals, 0/1/2 self-scores and a total. Answer in English.
setupPrompt: Use the attached chapter as the only source for the next activity. Please wait for my next request.

phases.name: upload
phases.caption: Open a new temporary chat and upload the chapter PDF.

phases.name: setup-generation
phases.caption: ChatGPT reads the uploaded chapter · accelerated.

phases.name: typing
phases.caption: Write the shortcut request as the second message.

phases.name: send
phases.caption: Send the shortcut as the second message.

phases.name: widget
phases.caption: Inspect the generated widget before using its controls.

phases.name: usage
phases.caption: Use the widget at normal speed.

actions.label: Self-score the first answer as complete.
Write the explanation about a prompt definition.
Review and self-score the prompt explanation.
Write the retrieval explanation with its limitation.
Reveal the third model answer and its two criteria.
Self-award two points to the completed retrieval explanation.
Inspect the complete worksheet and 6/6 total.
Reset the worksheet answers, reveals and scores.

deliveryNormalization.method: Aspect-preserving Lanczos downsample from 1664x1040 to 1440x900. H.264 CRF14; original 60 fps cadence and duration preserved. Native media retained in the ignored pre-pull review archive.
